150284.ov: Different people who are in serious crisis see a ray of hope when their lives get interlinked in an unexpected turn of events.

193932.ov: Poovalli Induchoodan (Mohanlal) is sentenced for six years prison life for murdering his classmate. Induchoodan, the only son of Justice Maranchery Karunakara Menon (Thilakan) was framed in the case by Manapally Madhavan Nambiar (Narayanan Nair) and his crony DYSP Sankaranarayanan (Bheeman Raghu) to take revenge on…

204044.ov: In the 1950s a village in Kerala is preparing itself to be included in the nation's electric grid. Things are looking up for villagers and everyone is optimistic about the progress that electrification will bring. However soon some trouble brews starting with petty quarrels on trees being felled for the power lines.

222988.ov: Sree Thankappan Nair (Nedumudi Venu) is a rich man, who has cheated his sister out of her property. Her son Achuthan (Maniyanpilla Raju) wants to reclaim the land forcibly taken by his uncle,as well as marry his daughter, Nandini (Menaka) with whom he was in love.

234636.ov: Unni, a journalist is in love with Vimla. The two get married against the wishes of their family. His life turns upside down when has to cover a celebrated writer who is about to die.

238476.ov: A group of children witness the robbery of a sword from a museum. However, they, along with Manu, set out to catch the culprits and also discover a shocking truth.

244492.ov: Kannan (Dileep) is the son of a fashion weaver Ayyapanashan (Babu Namboothiri). His father has sent him for fashion designing,but Kannan wants to make more money easier. His friends are Yesudas a.k.a Yesu (Lal),a goonda and Vasu (Kalabhavan Shajon).

276108.ov: After passing his prime years as a junior under a corrupt, dominant boss, Ravi becomes an independent solicitor. He takes on a challenge when he fights against his former employer in a murder case.

278028.ov: The film revolves around an active social worker, Rameshan Nair. He was leading a happy family life but problems begin when a girl enters his life.

280204.ov: The story is about a poor lorry driver named Bhaskaran (Kalabhavani Mani), who tries to give his son Kunjunni (Ashwin Thampi), a good education by sending him to a very expensive school. The rest of the story revolves around the events Kunjunni goes through in his life.

281356.ov: Elizabeth (Sukumari) has just retired as a college sports coach. Heeding to the suggestions from her students, she starts a beauty parlour with her retirement money. Her son Emil (Rahman) and brother Vakkachan (Nedumudi Venu) assist her in this venture.

341900.ov: A police officer investigates a series of killings involving IT professionals in Atlanta. He develops a rapport with the CEO of an IT company and the two join minds to stop the spree.

360588.ov: Kasargode Khadarbhai and his son, Kasimbhai, try to take revenge on a group of mimicry artists for sending Khadarbhai to prison.

412428.ov: Sughu falls in love with the daughter of a rich man. In order to marry his lover, he seeks illegal ways to make money, but life takes a turn when his plans become flop.

412684.ov: Businessman Ravuthar, who owns a haunted bungalow, tries several ways to exorcise the ghosts in the bungalow. With Ravuthar's permission, a young man named Anand sets his mind on defeating the invisible power in the bungalow.

494220.ov: The story of Gandhinagaril Unniyarcha is based in a village called Gandhinagar where Unniyarcha and her thugs run chit fund and gambling dens. All goes well for Unniyarcha until Kottayam Naseer takes charge of the Gandhinagar Police station and nabs her in a case. What happens next, forms the crux.

496012.ov: Nilavariyathe is a Malayalam movie starring Anumol K Manoharan and Bala Kumar in prominent roles. The movie also stars Santhosh Keezhattoor, Indrans, Kalasala Babu and Sajitha Madathil. It is a drama directed by Uthpal V Nayanar with Kanjangad Ramachandran as musician, forming part of the crew.

529164.ov: Moss Samuel lives with Tessy, a nine-year-old girl who is more than a sister and a friend to him. Both these orphans hatch mischievous plans daily to earn the day's meal.

542092.ov: Chef Sanjay meets candle designer Anjali during his quest for secret ingredients for his upcoming restaurant. Will he find the way to Anjali’s heart?

659084.ov: The lives of two martial arts instructors are upended when they become the targets of a gang, who decide to assassinate the brother and sister duo.

729484.ov: Pavithran and his friends have no ambitions and lead a carefree life. However, when they come across Maya, a string of unexpected events rocks their lives.

881420.ov: Momo a poor kid from Kerala wants to see Burj Khalifa, but he chooses to illegally fly to Dubai which gets him arrested and jailed.

911244.ov: Sanal departs Cochin Airport in the rain, journeying through Idukki's landscapes to meet Leena and fulfil their dream, while their hearts weave through shared memories of joy and sorrow.

950284.ov: When Luke Antony's wife goes missing, he sets off to search for her and stumbles upon the Balan family. However, terrorising events start occurring as Luke grows closer to them.

1021324.ov: Some Love Double Speaks.  This film is an Exposition of a Man who has long since grown tired of his wife

1066380.ov: Left-wing firebrand leader Pannyannoor Mukundhan forged in the crucible of left-wing politics of Malabar, always facing threats of violence and even murder. Ayyapa Das recently joined in the police and is assigned as his gunman. Das's father was a civil police officer, who passed away while still in service.

1084812.ov: Three college freshmen in Bangalore befriend an eccentric gangster to get revenge on their senior bullies.

1169164.ov: Vincent, a promising young IT Professional is striving to maintain the balance between his love life and his dream project. Vincent has been avoiding a serious commitment with Jasmine. Will he manage it?

1188364.ov: Archana is a 1966 Indian Malayalam film, directed by K. S. Sethumadhavan and produced by T. E. Vasudevan. The film stars Madhu, Sharada, K. P. Ummer and Adoor Bhasi.

1228940.ov: The story of the survival of a tribal student singer. It discusses the neglect and resistance of our society.

1616268.ov: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

1742604.ov: Through silence and imagery, Nizhal (The Shadow) explores how the echoes of the past linger in the present - A visual story where emotions speak louder than words.

1786508.ov: A heartfelt story of two best friends, their unspoken feelings, and the choices that change everything.
ml: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
